name: Minabe (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minabe town emblem in green and blue: a green stylised plum blossom with blue wavy lines.
history: Municipal flag of Minabe, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Minabe town emblem — a green stylised plum blossom with blue wavy lines
